import re
with open(GRAPH_TTL) as f:
    data=f.read()
# capture each triple ending statement: from subject to terminating " ." 
# simpler: capture subject line, then collect following lines until a line that ends statement (no trailing comma at end)
# Instead: split into blocks on blank? There are none. Use line-based: statement starts at line matching r'^bldg:' , ends at a line whose stripped form ends with ' ;' followed by another 'bldg:' OR with ' .'
# So: find each subject; collect the run of lines starting with it, up to the line that ends with ' .'

res={}
lines=data.splitlines()
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    m=re.match(r"bldg:(VAV_F4_Z\d\d)\.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor ;", l)
    if not m: 
        continue
    z=m.group(1)
    # collect following lines until '.'  at end
    block=[l]
    for j in range(i+1, len(lines)):
        block.append(lines[j])
        if lines[j].rstrip().endswith("."):
            break
    txt="\n".join(block)
    rr=re.search(r"tsref:([\w\-]+)", txt)
    res[z] = rr.group(1) if rr else None
    print(z, txt, "=>", res[z])
print(res)
